properties.summary: Process-local ephemeral backend for tests, demos, and evaluation.
properties.reason: Fully functional for evaluation but loses accepted events on restart; never durable.
properties.orderingNote: Process-local timer scheduling; no cross-endpoint ordering guarantee.
properties.failureRecovery: none; a restart is a clean slate by design.

acknowledgementBarrier.reason: Acceptance is in-memory only; a restart loses accepted events.

durableProtocolV1Acknowledgement.reason: Ephemeral state cannot provide protocol-v1 durable acknowledgement.

restartRecovery.reason: All state is process-local and disappears on restart.

durableIdempotency.reason: Idempotency ledger is bounded and process-local.

leaseFencing.reason: In-process fencing tokens prevent stale settlement within one process.

multiReplicaSafe.reason: State is not shared across processes or replicas.

multiProcessSafe.reason: State is not shared across processes.

replayRedrive.reason: Dead jobs can be redriven within the running process.

objectStorePayloadBackend.reason: The evaluation profile keeps ciphertext in memory and never writes durable object payloads.
